news.title: Wells Fargo Moves to Underweight
news.text: Wells Fargo assigned Oscar Health an Underweight rating with a $10 price target, highlighting worries about rising utilization trends.

news.title: UBS Downgrades Oscar to Sell
news.text: UBS cut its rating on Oscar Health to Sell with an $11 target, citing escalating medical costs and profitability risks.

news.title: Revised 2025 Guidance Signals Higher Losses
news.text: Oscar Health widened its 2025 operating loss outlook to $200–$300 million due to higher medical costs but lifted revenue guidance to $12.0–$12.2 billion.

news.title: Barclays Trims Price Target to $11
news.text: Barclays maintained a cautious view on Oscar Health while lowering its price target to $11 amid concerns about margin pressures.

news.title: Q2 2025 Results Show Higher MLR
news.text: Oscar Health reported a Q2 operating loss of $230.5 million on $2.9 billion revenue as its medical loss ratio climbed to 91.1%, though 2026 profitability goals were reaffirmed.

news.title: Convertible Notes Offering Announced
news.text: Oscar Health priced $355 million of 2.25% convertible senior subordinated notes due 2030, sending shares lower on expected dilution.

news.title: Wells Fargo Conference Presentation
news.text: At the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference, CFO Scott Blackley detailed Oscar Health's plans to manage utilization trends and navigate regulatory shifts.

news.title: Motley Fool Weighs Investment Case
news.text: A Motley Fool analysis discussed whether Oscar Health shares were a buy, focusing on growth prospects versus ongoing losses.

news.title: Goldman Sachs Begins Coverage at Neutral
news.text: Goldman Sachs launched coverage with a Neutral rating and $17 target, balancing improving operating metrics against near-term profitability concerns.

news.title: Strategic Partnership with Elektra Health
news.text: Oscar Health announced the HelloMeno menopause-focused plan with Elektra Health and highlighted new AI investments to enhance member services.
